notes.text: The received 7:3:13 has two radishes, the time window, camel-load and ruling. The directly cited 7:4 is a different discussion.
The Yerushalmi explicitly answers that they were sown after the New Year.
The primary wording specifies buying vegetables immediately after the sabbatical year. Sheviit and Demai give bearing on the rule.
The direct passage supplies buying and immediacy. Keep the original Hebrew conserved.
